# Financial Engineering & Payoff Logic Checklist: Equity Accumulator & Decumulator Products

**Purpose**: Validate the precision, completeness, and mathematical soundness of requirements for share accumulation, decumulation, 2x gearing liabilities, and dual settlement mechanics before implementation
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are deterministic mathematical equations specified for both physical share quantity commitments and cash mark-to-market P&L across all spot price ranges? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-005, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK002 Are baseline parameters (`strike_price`, `knock_out_barrier_pct`, `gearing_ratio`, `daily_share_count`, `total_observation_days`, `guaranteed_days`) explicitly required for accumulator definitions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Are share delivery and disposal mechanics fully defined for both physical equity delivery and cash-difference settlement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Clarifications 2026-10-02]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements documented for how the contract handles early knock-out cancellation when guaranteed accumulation days are configured? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for the calculation of average acquisition cost per share when gearing causes variable share lots across observation periods? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Clarity & Mathematical Precision

- [ ] CHK006 Is the 2x gearing trigger threshold unambiguously specified relative to the contractual strike price ($P < K$ for Accumulators, $P > K$ for Decumulators)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the early cancellation condition quantified with strict boundary inequality operators (e.g. $P \ge B_{KO}$ vs. $P > B_{KO}$)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the default observation frequency (daily trading days vs. calendar days) explicitly defined without ambiguous wording? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the definition of "mark-to-market P&L" quantified against prevailing simulated spot price rather than initial fixing spot? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK010 Are rounding and precision rules specified for fractional share quantities resulting from gearing calculations? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Scenario & Boundary Coverage

- [ ] CHK011 Are requirements specified for the scenario where underlying spot price exactly equals the strike price ($P = K$)? [Coverage, Boundary condition]
- [ ] CHK012 Are requirements specified for the scenario where underlying spot price exactly touches the Knock-Out barrier ($P = B_{KO}$)? [Coverage, Boundary condition]
- [ ] CHK013 Are requirements defined for Day 1 immediate Knock-Out cancellation prior to any daily accumulation? [Coverage, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK014 Are contractual requirements defined for how trading holidays and non-scheduled market closures affect total observation days? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK015 Are requirements specified for the interaction between guaranteed days and intra-period knock-out barrier breaches? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Edge Cases & Tail-Risk Handling

- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements defined for extreme market drawdown scenarios where simulated underlying spot approaches zero ($P \to 0$)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the maximum possible financial cash liability under 2x gearing explicitly bounded and formulated in the requirements? [Edge Case, Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 Are requirement behaviors documented for corporate actions (e.g. stock splits, special dividends) during active accumulator tenors? [Gap, Assumption]
- [ ] CHK019 Are European daily close vs. American continuous intraday barrier monitoring rules unambiguous and testable? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Clarifications 2026-10-02]

## Traceability & Consistency

- [ ] CHK020 Do functional requirements align with the Dual Display presentation decisions captured in the clarification session? [Traceability, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the single-underlying equity scope consistently maintained across all accumulator and decumulator functional requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Clarifications 2026-10-02]
- [ ] CHK022 Do accumulator requirements comply strictly with Constitution Principle I (Zero-Retention Ephemeral RAM execution) and Principle II (Counterparty Anonymization)? [Compliance, Spec §FR-010, Constitution §I, §II]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
